cohort: 5392 neonates born between 2010 and 2014 in a level 1 maternity
finding: The study found that the use of neonatal eucapnic pH at birth identified fewer cases of severe metabolic acidosis compared to conventional criteria, suggesting it may be a more accurate measure for identifying neonates who require interventions such as cerebral hypothermia.
mod_finding: 80% of the cases of severe neonatal metabolic acidosis were born by cesarean section or instrumental delivery.
birth_weight: Recorded but not specified in the abstract
